source.usage: User-provided game assets, local reconstruction and comparison only. Original rights retained.
source.audioPolicy: Source-sample-exact PCM; original MP3s preserved as provenance. Browser gapless MP3 decoding does not match Flash sample boundaries.
imageProfileLimitations: Source premultiplied bytes are exact; subsequent Canvas blending, filtering and geometric coverage can still differ from native Flash.
Native Windows Flash 34.0.0.384, High, 96 DPI evidence; not historical Flash10 implementation equivalence.
1024 fixed getVector samples per JPEG (4096 total) equal the stage pixels; not proof of all 480000 native memory pixels per image.
Only four complete original sky JPEG decode outputs; no UI/actors/gameplay frames, fitted pixels, resizing or color correction.

lossless2.policy: Original premultiplied ARGB exact round-trip; unchanged canonical PNGs.
